routing_warnings.description: The false records saying the connected client had minted twice concern user-owned NFT dashboard synchronization rather than project-wide supply statistics.
The report that the dashboard showed zero NFTs primarily concerns the connected user's owned-NFT records; the zero prize-pool observation belongs to REQ_PRIZE_POOL_BALANCE_DISPLAY.

The Home-page Top Referrals value concerns public referral aggregation; the prize-pool value belongs to REQ_PRIZE_POOL_BALANCE_DISPLAY, while the message does not state that the displayed two-mint total is incorrect.
The claimed totals for referrals, tickets, earnings, and NFT details describe user reward-accounting data rather than project-wide mint and supply statistics.
